title: Publish the source access-target classifier without changing permission policy
summary: Expose the exact existing access-target classifier under a clear public name so StateCivics can replace six private imports/calls without copying policy. The predicate does not grant access or establish public disclosure.
in_scope: Expose matter.access.is_source_access_target as the existing predicate and retain _public as the identical callable.
Document validated-reference preconditions, receipt/control/internal projection exclusions and the continuing grant/currentness/revocation boundary.
Record dev17 receiving acceptance and ship the API in a separately pinned dev18 SDK with frozen 1.0/1.1 wires unchanged.
out_of_scope: Changes to access policy, source classification rules, schema/wire versions, authentication, provider calls, qualification, StateCivics code/image builds or deployment.
implementation: Read the existing MAT-072 access contract and exact _public rule; do not add another policy implementation or new authorization inference.
Expose is_source_access_target(ref), preserving _public object identity and behavior for existing imports. Inputs are already validated record/entity/pinned references.
Verify type/namespace boundaries and unchanged actual scope/egress/READ/revocation checks; check the installed public import and old/new identity.

acceptance.criterion: The public callable preserves the exact existing classification and old import.
acceptance.verification: Assert old/new callable identity, expected booleans for supported record kinds, exact internal namespace prefix boundaries and nonmutation.

acceptance.criterion: Classification cannot be mistaken for permission or broaden a grant.
acceptance.verification: A true candidate with a foreign scope still fails HostAccessPolicy; excluded bookkeeping cannot be added as a source grant. Run existing audience/provider, revoked grant, parent closure and READ guard tests unchanged.

acceptance.criterion: The installed SDK provides an explicit, compatible handoff.
acceptance.verification: Import the public name from the wheel outside checkout, verify alias identity and pinned byte inventory, pass frozen schema/vector checks and publish source/wheel version and receiving limitations.

tests: Assert old/new callable identity, expected booleans for supported record kinds, exact internal namespace prefix boundaries and nonmutation.

A true candidate with a foreign scope still fails HostAccessPolicy; excluded bookkeeping cannot be added as a source grant. Run existing audience/provider, revoked grant, parent closure and READ guard tests unchanged.
Import the public name from the wheel outside checkout, verify alias identity and pinned byte inventory, pass frozen schema/vector checks and publish source/wheel version and receiving limitations.
risks: A true source-target classification is not public disclosure or authorization. False excludes bookkeeping from source grants; it does not grant unrestricted reads.

reuse.application: Use one callable for legacy/public callers; preserve the actual HostAccessPolicy and AccessService owners.

sources: Owner-relayed StateCivics dev17 receiving receipt: request to publish matter.access._public (six StateCivics call sites), 2026-10-31
